name: Alcor Micro,Corp.
summary: Alcor Micro,Corp. designs, develops, and markets integrated semiconductors and software solutions for the personal computer peripherals and consumer electronics in China, Taiwan, South Korea, Japan, and internationally. It offers application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) services, including front-end design, IP design, physical implementation, wafer foundry solutions, advanced packaging solutions, product and reliability engineering, and product management services, as well as AI design and wireless platform solutions.
